call.title: Introductory call transcript
call.text:
I DO! VENDOR INTRODUCTION
Call transcript | November 1, 2026, 10:00 a.m.
Rep: Jamie Rivera | Vendor: Alex Morgan, Golden Hour Photography
FICTIONAL SAMPLE SOURCE

[00:00] Jamie: Tell me about what you do and who you are a good fit for.
[00:19] Alex Morgan: We offer Wedding photography, engagement sessions, second photographer. Our style is Candid documentary; warm, true-to-life portraits. Capacity-wise, One wedding per team per day; two teams maximum.

[02:10] Jamie: Walk me through what's included and what you need.
[02:22] Alex Morgan: Standard service is 8 hours. The team is Lead photographer + second photographer. We can customize with Extra coverage, albums, engagement sessions. Exclusions are Raw files, videography, and print products. From the venue or client, we need Family photo list; access to getting-ready rooms.

[06:05] Jamie: How do bookings and payments work?
[06:20] Alex Morgan: The deposit is 30% non-refundable retainer. The balance is due 30 days before the event. We recommend booking 9–12 months ahead.
[07:02] Jamie: And changes or cancellations?
[07:14] Alex Morgan: Retainer is non-refundable; within 30 days the full balance is due. For rescheduling: One date change within 12 months, subject to availability.

[09:35] Jamie: What happens on the day?
[09:46] Alex Morgan: Arrive 45 minutes before coverage starts. Our backup plan is Two camera bodies per photographer; dual-card recording; backup associate.
[10:50] Jamie: What about delivery and deadlines?
[11:02] Alex Morgan: The website says six weeks for the gallery. I need to confirm our current standard. I'll email you the latest timeline.

[13:12] Jamie: Please also confirm the package prices and send insurance documentation.
[13:25] Alex Morgan: The website rates are out of date. I'll send our current rate card and a follow-up email. I still need to send our certificate.

[14:00] Jamie: Thanks. We will keep the profile pending until the documents are reviewed.
